description: Walks the folder and records what is there: how many files and folders, their sizes, hidden files, links and timestamps. No file is opened. It then reads only what that walk stored to say whether the folder has a recognisable structure (a project, a dataset layout, an archive, backups) and how much changed since the previous walk. Cheap, and nothing is written into the folder. Resource Explorer leads this definition: when Egeria can read the folder, Egeria's Folder Survey leads and is run from the file system's folder-survey card, and this definition's walk stops and says so. A step that has not run shows "Not yet run", never an empty answer.
